description:
A chemical storage facility has recovered 5 unlabeled bottles (A, B, C, D, E) and 5 loose labels after a flood. Your task is to match each bottle to its correct chemical name by comparing the lab's physical property measurements (Boiling Point, Flash Point, Solubility) against the official data in CAMEO Chemicals. 

Starting from the CAMEO Chemicals website (https://cameochemicals.noaa.gov/), look up the physical properties for the 5 candidate chemicals: Acetonitrile, Cyclohexane, Tetrahydrofuran, Pyridine, and Ethyl Acetate.

Compare them to the Lab Measurements provided in the file `~/Desktop/lab_measurements.txt`.

Create a report at `~/Documents/chemical_identification_report.txt` using the exact format:

FORENSIC IDENTIFICATION REPORT
==============================
Bottle A: [Chemical Name] (Ref BP: [Value], Ref FP: [Value])
Bottle B: [Chemical Name] (Ref BP: [Value], Ref FP: [Value])
Bottle C: [Chemical Name] (Ref BP: [Value], Ref FP: [Value])
Bottle D: [Chemical Name] (Ref BP: [Value], Ref FP: [Value])
Bottle E: [Chemical Name] (Ref BP: [Value], Ref FP: [Value])

Ensure you include the reference values you found in CAMEO to justify your match.
